usage:
(defn usage [key]
  (reduce (fn [acc c]
            (if (= (get c "key") key)
              (+ acc (get c "tokens" 0))
              acc))
          0
          (get (state) "calls" [])))
top_spender:
(defn top_spender []
  (let [ks (call_keys)]
    (when (pos? (count ks))
      (reduce (fn [best k] (if (> (cost k) (cost best)) k best))
              (first ks)
              (rest ks)))))
cost:
(defn cost [key]
  (let [prices (get (state) "prices" {})]
    (/ (round (* 100
                  (reduce (fn [acc c]
                            (if (= (get c "key") key)
                              (+ acc (* (get c "tokens" 0)
                                        (/ (get prices (get c "model") 0) 100000.0)))
                              acc))
                          0
                          (get (state) "calls" []))))
       100)))
set_price:
(defn set_price [model cents_per_1k_tokens]
  (when-not (and (number? cents_per_1k_tokens) (not (neg? cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    (throw (ex-info "price must be a non-negative number" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["prices" (str model)] cents_per_1k_tokens)
  cents_per_1k_tokens)
record_usage:
(defn record_usage [key model tokens]
  (when-not (and (string? key) (pos? (count key)))
    (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? model) (pos? (count model)))
    (throw (ex-info "model must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (whole_count tokens) (pos? tokens))
    (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a positive whole number" {})))
  (when-some [q (token_quota key)]
    (when (> (+ (usage key) tokens) q)
      (throw (ex-info "quota exceeded" {}))))
  (swap-state! update "calls" (fnil conj [])
               {"key" key "model" model "tokens" tokens})
  (usage key))
set_quota:
(defn set_quota [key tokens]
  (let [k (str key)]
    (when-not (and (whole_count tokens) (not (neg? tokens)))
      (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a non-negative whole number" {})))
    (when (> (usage k) tokens)
      (throw (ex-info "quota is below tokens already used" {})))
    (swap-state! assoc-in ["quotas" k] tokens)
    tokens))
